info.name: Vitran API
info.description:
Vitran marketplace backend — **116 `/api/v1` routes** synced with code (plus `/health` and `/api/v2` mirror). Taxonomy: Shopify import + admin names/icons. Follows: `/me/follows/shops`. Wishlist: `/me/favorites/products`. Profile & persons: `/me/profile/sizing`, `/me/profile/notify`, `/me/persons`. Picked-for-you matches: **Product Matches — Me** (`GET /me/matches`) + home rails (`GET /home/screen`, `GET /home/sections/picked-for-you`, `GET /me/home/feed?product_matches=…`).

**Setup**
1. Import this collection.
2. Set `baseUrl` to the API origin only — no path suffix.
   - Local: `http://localhost:8080`
   - Production: `https://vitran.ir` (do **not** append `/api` to `baseUrl`)
3. Run **Auth → Register** (pending signup in Redis — no `users` row) then **Verify OTP** with the SMS code. OTP is **not** in the JSON unless `EXPOSE_OTP_IN_RESPONSE=true`. Or **Login** if already verified.
4. `accessToken` / `refreshToken` / `tempToken` are saved automatically from auth responses.

**Roles** (hierarchical): `user` < `admin` < `super_admin`. Signup assigns `user`. Higher roles inherit every lower role's permissions. A `user` may be a viewer (`shop_types: []`), own retail shops, own wholesale shops, or both — see `GET /auth/me` `shop_types`. Shop ownership is `shops.owner_id`, not a role. `/seller/*` accepts a `user` (or higher) token; mutations still require the caller to own the shop. After this change, refresh or re-login so JWTs do not still list `customer`/`seller`.

**API versioning**
- Business routes: `/api/v1/...` and mirrored `/api/v2/...`.
- `GET /health`, `GET /api/v1/health`, `GET /api/v2/health`.

**Plans (slugs)**
- `free`, `starter`, `growth`, `business` — list via **Plans — Public**.

**Referrals**
- **Referrals → Get my referral profile** (authenticated user) saves `referralCode`.
- First paid purchase by referred user grants 1 month Starter credit to both parties.
- **Apply subscription credit** on Free/Starter shops.

**Static pages (CMS)**
- Public: **Static Pages — Public** (`about-us`, `terms-of-service`, `privacy-policy`, `service-levels`).
- Admin: **Static Pages — Admin**.

**List pagination**
**Pagination:** **Cursor mode (recommended for infinite scroll):** omit `page`, use `per_page` (or `limit`, default 20, max 100) and optional `cursor` from previous `next_cursor`. Response: `{ per_page, has_more, next_cursor?, results }` (no total). **Page mode:** pass `page=1` for `{ page, per_page, last_page, from, to, total, has_more, results }`.

**Response envelope**
```json
{ "success", "message", "code", "data", "errors" }
```
- `code: 1` = success, `code: -2` = validation error

request.description: Phone-first availability. **Does not send SMS.** Returns `status` (`available` / `registered` / `pending_verification` / `unverified` / `inactive`), `next_step`, and live `otp_ttl` / `resend_after` when a code or cooldown is active. Call after the user finishes entering a number so the client can route to register, login, or verify without 409/404/429 loops. Rate-limited with login (`RuleLogin`).

request.description: Starts signup: validates phone/password, stores a **pending signup** in Redis (**10 min**, `max(5 min, TEMP_TOKEN_TTL_MIN)`), sends a 6-digit **OTP (5 min TTL)**, returns `temp_token` (**10 min**) plus `otp_ttl`, `otp_expires_at`, and `resend_after` so the client can show a countdown. **No `users` row is created yet.** Prefer **Check phone** first. Next step is **Verify OTP** before the code expires. Optional `referral_code` — or use **Register with referral code**. `otp_code` appears in the body only when `EXPOSE_OTP_IN_RESPONSE=true` (development). Already-verified phone → `409`. Re-register while the OTP is still valid resumes the same code (new `temp_token`, remaining `otp_ttl`) — no extra SMS and no `429`. A new SMS is sent only after the 5-minute OTP expires. Use **Resend OTP** to force a new SMS (90 s cooldown → `429`).

request.description: Same as Register: pending signup in Redis (**10 min**) + OTP (**5 min**) + `temp_token` (**10 min**). `referral_code` is stored and attached when **Verify OTP** succeeds (not at register time). Set `referralCode` from **Referrals → Get my referral profile** (referrer must be logged in first). Rewards trigger on the referred user's **first** paid shop plan purchase.

Complete signup. Body: `temp_token` from Register + 6-digit SMS OTP (`code`). OTP is valid for **5 minutes**; `temp_token` for **10 minutes** (`TEMP_TOKEN_TTL_MIN`). **Correct OTP** → inserts a verified `users` row and returns tokens. **Wrong/expired OTP** → `400`; no account is created. After 5 failed attempts the pending signup is dropped. Expired `temp_token` → `401`. Enter the SMS code in `code` (or `{{otpCode}}` only if you enabled `EXPOSE_OTP_IN_RESPONSE` locally).

request.description: Issues a **new 5-minute** verification OTP for a **pending signup** (Redis) or a leftover unverified user. Success returns `otp_ttl` / `otp_expires_at` / `resend_after`. **90 s** cooldown after the last send (`429` + `Retry-After` + remaining TTL and a fresh `temp_token` if pending). Does not refresh the pending-signup TTL (default 10 min from Register). Unknown or already-verified phones → `404`. `otp_code` only when `EXPOSE_OTP_IN_RESPONSE=true`.

request.description: Sends a reset OTP (**5 min TTL**) only if the phone belongs to a **verified** user. Unknown or unverified phones → `404`. `otp_code` only when `EXPOSE_OTP_IN_RESPONSE=true`.
